Primary outcome: Change from baseline to 60 hours in Woodcock-Johnson III Visual-Auditory Learning-Delayed standard score (long-term memory).
Primary outcome: Change from baseline to 60 hours in Woodcock-Johnson III General Intellectual Ability composite standard score.
